i.norm:
Subtracting a zero duration must return the very same instance unchanged.

The instant is built from a negative nano adjustment (-1660 nanos relative to second -1660). The factory normalises the nanos into the range 0..999,999,999 by borrowing one whole second, so the instant becomes -1661 seconds plus 999,998,340 nanos. Subtracting {@link Duration#ZERO} is a no-op that short-circuits to {@code this}.
